plan.description: The plan as it is now, with what it may have left on disk.

EventId.description:
History event id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one store.

RecoveryPlan.description: One journal plan that recovery has not closed.

id.description: The plan's ID, for `recovery drop`. Read from the journal folder name.

label.description: The write the plan belongs to.

root.description: The folder the write ran under.

status.description:
`pending` until the next write tries to undo it, `interrupted` after a
run failed, `dropped` after `recovery drop`.

recovery_attempts.description: Recovery runs that failed to undo the plan.

recovery_error.description: What the last failed run hit.

touched_paths.description:
Paths the write touched. Each one can hold the old state, the new
state, or a half-done change.

backups.description: Saved copies of the files the write changed.

PlanId.description:
Journal plan id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one journal.

PlanStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of one journal plan.

Invariant: a row starts `Pending` (written before the plan's first step)
and ends `Done`, `Failed`, `Reversed`, or `Dropped`; `Interrupted` and
`Reversed` are the only states [`crate::journal::reconcile`] ever writes,
and only for a row it found still `Pending` at startup - `Reversed` when
it could undo every recorded step, `Interrupted` when undoing one failed.
Only `recovery drop` writes `Dropped`, and only over `Interrupted`.

oneOf.description: The manifest and plan are durable; steps have not all run yet.
Every step ran; the mutation is durable.

Found `Pending` at startup with no step recorded, so there was
nothing to undo.

Found `Pending` at startup and every recorded step was undone, in
reverse order, through [`ScopeFs`].

Found `Pending` at startup - the process died mid-plan - and
undoing at least one recorded step hit an I/O error, so the plan's
on-disk state cannot be trusted as either the pre-plan or the
post-plan shape.

The person gave up an `Interrupted` plan. Recovery no longer retries
it, and its files stay as the last attempt left them.

RecoveryBackup.description: A file a plan saved before it changed it.

original.description: The file the copy came from.
